::: {.callout-note}
## The data
We will use the **CDISC Pilot study (CDISCPILOT01)**, a public mock Alzheimer's trial of xanomeline patches vs. placebo. It ships as R data frames in the [`{safetyData}`](https://github.com/SafetyGraphics/safetyData) package, so anyone can reproduce this post.

The endpoint is **Time to First Dermatologic Event** (skin reactions at the patch site). The [R Consortium submitted this same KM figure to the FDA](https://github.com/RConsortium/submissions-pilot3-adam-to-fda) in its R-based Submission Pilot 3, and the ADaM data behind it was built with `{admiral}`. So this isn't a toy example.

:::

# ADAM Dataset: ADTTE 

## Analysis Dataset for Time-To-Event
To build a Kaplan-Meier curve we need one ADaM dataset, ADTTE, which is derived from ADSL and ADAE. Visually, ADTTE looks like this:

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true


adtte <- safetyData::adam_adtte %>% 
  datatable(
    class = "compact nowrap stripe hover",
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(
      scrollX = TRUE,
      pagelength = 10,
      autoWidth = TRUE
    )
  )
adtte
```

## ADTTE column descriptions

| Variable | Name | In this study |
|-------------------|-------------------|----------------------------------|
| `STUDYID` | Study Identifier | Always `CDISCPILOT01`; identifies the trial |
| `SITEID` | Study Site Identifier | Which of the 17 clinical sites enrolled the patient (`701`–`718`) |
| `USUBJID` | Unique Subject Identifier | The patient key (e.g., `01-701-1015`) that links ADTTE to every other dataset; 254 patients, one row each |
| `AGE` | Age | Age in years at baseline (51–89) |
| `AGEGR1` | Pooled Age Group 1 | Age category: `<65`, `65-80`, `>80` |
| `AGEGR1N` | Pooled Age Group 1 (N) | Numeric code for `AGEGR1` (`1`, `2`, `3`), used for sorting |
| `RACE` | Race | `WHITE`, `BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN`, `AMERICAN INDIAN OR ALASKA NATIVE` |
| `RACEN` | Race (N) | Numeric code for `RACE`, used for sorting |
| `SEX` | Sex | `F` or `M` |
| `TRTSDT` | Date of First Exposure to Treatment | First dose date; copied from ADSL |
| `TRTEDT` | Date of Last Exposure to Treatment | Last dose date; copied from ADSL |
| `TRTDUR` | Duration of Treatment (days) | Days on treatment, from `TRTSDT` to `TRTEDT` (1–212) |
| `TRTP` | Planned Treatment | The arm the patient was assigned to |
| `TRTA` | Actual Treatment | The arm the patient actually received; the grouping variable for the KM curves |
| `TRTAN` | Actual Treatment (N) | Numeric code for `TRTA`: `0` = Placebo, `54` = Low Dose, `81` = High Dose (the daily dose in mg) |
| `PARAM` | Parameter Description | `Time to First Dermatologic Event`; the full name of the endpoint |
| `PARAMCD` | Parameter Code | `TTDE`, so we filter to the endpoint we want |
| `AVAL` | Analysis Value | Number of days from `STARTDT` to `ADT`, counting the start day as Day 1; the x-axis of the KM curve |
| `STARTDT` | Time-to-Event Origin Date | Day 1 of the clock; here it's the first dose date (`TRTSDT`) |
| `ADT` | Analysis Date | The date the clock stopped, either the event date or the censoring date |
| `CNSR` | Censor | `0` = had a dermatologic event, `1` = censored |
| `EVNTDESC` | Event or Censoring Description | Why the clock stopped: `Dematologic Event Occured` (typo is in the original data) or `Study Completion Date` |
| `SRCDOM` | Source Domain | Which dataset `ADT` came from: `ADAE` for events, `ADSL` for censored patients |
| `SRCVAR` | Source Variable | Which column `ADT` came from: `ASTDT` (AE start date) or `RFENDT` (end-of-study date) |
| `SRCSEQ` | Source Sequence Number | Which row in ADAE the event came from (matches `AESEQ`); blank for censored patients |
| `SAFFL` | Safety Population Flag | `Y` = received at least one dose; all 254 patients are in the safety population |
